音频PCM、无线业务、模拟电源/充电/电池ADC、物理屏幕扫描/颜色及触摸配准仍未验收。
3D保留厂家CAD或尺寸依据；UNKNOWN内部与推测厚度/排针不能用作装配尺寸。
此款无TF插槽，运行时不提供虚构SD卡接口。
原厂最终快照 2027 种RGB颜色。 详见native-stop-summaries及逐版本限制。
Original full image boots real C6 ROM for5.000 emulated seconds, zero exceptions;52 RAMWR/411640 pixels;2027 RGB colors.
Final screenshot visibly shows upright DrawPanel and AIChats home icons. Interaction/audio/RF acceptance remains open.

First run falsely required ES7210 control supply exactly3.3V and asserted. After primary ES7210 Rev21§6 validation, accept1.6..3.6V I2C supply; initial failed evidence retained under before-es7210-supply-range.

Physical CO5300 identity is retained despite SH8601 class naming in official BSP2.0.0. Exact registry ZIP and source are retained. X gap22, Y0; source does not establish guessed physical touch calibration.
Display GPIO11 and touch GPIO10 resets are separate; ALDO2 is not glass logic power. This board has no TF socket and no TCA9554.

ES7210 Rev21 section6 allows1.6..3.6V control supplies. A first overly strict3.3V-only gate caused a recorded assertion; corrected source-backed range yields upright DrawPanel/AIChats home at5s,2027 colors and0 exceptions. PCM and analogue operating conditions remain unverified.
2.06 C6 product dimension photo supplies42×50.8×12.9 mm body; linked dimension PDF is labelled S3 and is not an exact C6 solid CAD source. Unknown internal PCB is visibly labelled.
